name: @sand/stash
description: Prompts saved from the composer for later, with their images and files, shared by every thread and device

sand.label: Stash
sand.summary: Save a prompt for later with Ctrl+S or a long-press on send, then put it back in any thread

uses.server: the page cannot list or save stashed prompts
uses.keys: no Ctrl+S or Ctrl+Shift+S; use the tab or a long-press on send
uses.notify: no Undo after stashing and no warnings when putting back
